name: Document_Management_System
description: Internal dealer and letter management system (MERN, MVC)

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
